Load the stats.ncaa.org to ESPN MBB crosswalks

Source: R/load_crosswalk.R
load_mbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk.Rd

stats.ncaa.org gives a team a new numeric id every season and spells school names in AP style; ESPN keeps one id per school. These loaders read the all-seasons crosswalk tables on the mbb_crosswalk release tag that join the two, so the load_ncaa_mbb_*() tables can be matched to the ESPN-based load_mbb_*() tables.

  • load_mbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk(): one row per season and stats.ncaa.org team id (2009-10 onward), with the ESPN team and both sources' conference for that season. The same table as sportsdataverse-py's ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk(league = "mbb").

  • load_mbb_ncaa_espn_schools(): one row per NCAA school (org id) with its ESPN team.

  • load_mbb_ncaa_espn_school_seasons(): one row per school, sport and season with that season's stats.ncaa.org team id. It covers both sports (sport is mbb or wbb), since an org id is shared by every team of a school.

The ESPN ids (espn_team_id, espn_conference_id) are returned as integer, matching the ESPN loaders. ncaa_team_id and ncaa_org_id are integer, as published and as in sportsdataverse-py and wehoop; the load_ncaa_mbb_*() loaders keep the NCAA ids as character (e.g. the id of load_ncaa_mbb_team_ids()), so cast one side before joining them. season is the "YYYY-YY" string the release uses. The files are parquet, so these loaders need the arrow package.

Usage

load_mbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk()

load_mbb_ncaa_espn_schools()

load_mbb_ncaa_espn_school_seasons()

Source

The mbb_crosswalk release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/mbb_crosswalk.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per season and stats.ncaa.org team (load_mbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk()).

col_nametypesdescription
seasoncharacterSeason, "YYYY-YY" (e.g. "2024-25").
ncaa_team_idintegerstats.ncaa.org team id for that season (a new id every season).
ncaa_org_idintegerstats.ncaa.org school (org) id, stable across seasons.
ncaa_teamcharacterstats.ncaa.org school name (AP style, e.g. Ark.-Pine Bluff).
ncaa_conferencecharacterstats.ncaa.org conference that season.
conference_idcharacterSportsDataverse group id of that season's conference (e.g. mbb:big-ten), as in load_mbb_groups(); NA when unmatched.
espn_team_idintegerESPN team id; NA when the school could not be matched.
espn_display_namecharacterESPN team display name.
espn_locationcharacterESPN team location.
espn_mascotcharacterESPN team mascot.
espn_abbreviationcharacterESPN team abbreviation.
espn_conference_namecharacterESPN conference name that season.
espn_conference_idintegerESPN conference (group) id that season.
match_methodcharacterHow the team was matched: exact, dict, alias, org (the school's ESPN id from its other seasons) or unmatched.

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per NCAA school (load_mbb_ncaa_espn_schools()).

col_nametypesdescription
ncaa_org_idintegerstats.ncaa.org school (org) id, stable across seasons.
ncaa_teamcharacterstats.ncaa.org school name.
espn_team_idintegerESPN team id of the school.
espn_display_namecharacterESPN team display name.

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per school, sport and season (load_mbb_ncaa_espn_school_seasons()).

col_nametypesdescription
ncaa_org_idintegerstats.ncaa.org school (org) id, stable across seasons.
sportcharactermbb (men's) or wbb (women's): an org id is shared by every team of a school.
seasoncharacterSeason, "YYYY-YY" (e.g. "2024-25").
ncaa_team_idintegerstats.ncaa.org team id of the school's team in that sport and season.
espn_team_idintegerESPN team id of the school.

See also

The WBB twins in wehoop, load_wbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk() and friends.

Other MBB Crosswalk Functions: load_nba_team_crosswalk(), mbb_player_crosswalk(), mbb_schedule_crosswalk(), mbb_team_crosswalk()
